signal_quality_rules.insufficient_variation: Fewer than 24 observations or only one unique trend value
signal_quality_rules.informative: At least three unique trend values

limitations: Google Trends indices are normalized within each series and do not represent visitor counts.
The digital score measures changes in search interest, not absolute tourism market size.
The development context score is kept separate from the digital-demand score.
Socioeconomic indicators use their latest available year and may differ by district.
Three districts have insufficient socioeconomic coverage for a development-context score.
Categories are monitoring signals, not causal claims or investment recommendations.
